description: USDA-ARS Central Plains Experimental Range (CPER), ~15,000 acres of shortgrass steppe in Weld County, CO. Real-time soil-moisture mapping domain. Reference point: NEON site CPER, domain D10, 40.815536 / -104.745591, ~1650 m.

bbox.comment: Approximate CPER boundary; replace with the ARS pasture-boundary extent once provided (SPEC.md section 11 Q2/Q10).

date_range.comment: Default fetch window for characterize/historical runs. SCAN Nunn #1 soil moisture reaches back to 1997-03.

analysis.min_stations_for_regression_comment: M4 tier 2 (random-forest regression on covariates) needs this many DISTINCT reporting locations before it engages -- deliberately higher than min_reporting_stations. The public network gives ~7, and a 49-covariate forest fitted to 7 points is decoration, so tier 2 stays off and the output records why. Raise/lower only with a reason.
analysis.m4_uncertainty_comment: decorrelation_length_m sets how fast the distance term in the uncertainty layer saturates (it saturates AT the observed between-station spread, not at an invented constant). station_free_zone_penalty is added in quadrature wherever a zone has no station. min_zone_polygon_ha only tags small polygons in the geojson; nothing is dropped.

sm_thresholds.comment: Volumetric fraction breakpoints -> class, tuned down from the forest defaults: shortgrass-steppe sandy loams rarely exceed ~0.35 m3/m3.

stations.name: Nunn 7 NNE (Ag. Res. Svc. Central Plains Exp. Range)
stations.comment: lat/lon as published in the daily01 data rows (verified 2026-07-29); the fetcher still reads the per-row columns at fetch time. Config values feed static-branch station_covariates extraction.

stations.name: CPER
stations.comment: lat/lon from the AWDB /stations metadata endpoint (verified 2026-07-29); the fetcher still queries it at fetch time. Config values feed static-branch station_covariates extraction.

stations.name: Nunn #1
stations.comment: lat/lon from the AWDB /stations metadata endpoint (verified 2026-07-29); the fetcher still queries it at fetch time. Config values feed static-branch station_covariates extraction.

stations.name: NEON CPER soil plots SP1-SP5
stations.sensor: NEON DP1.00094.001 soil water content profiles
stations.comment: Five instrumented plots; per-plot coordinates and depths come from the sensor_positions file at fetch time

awdb.comment: NRCS AWDB REST API, same service as SNOTEL. Gotcha: /stations silently ignores stateCodes/networkCodes; always filter by explicit stationTriplets.

neon.available_note: DP1.00094.001 at CPER starts 2016-07 (120 months verified 2026-07-29) and publishes ~1 month behind. characterize fans out one fetch job per month across this range; months outside it are not requested.
neon.comment: Requires NEON_TOKEN in the job environment (injected by the generator via add_env). DP1.00006.001 precip is NOT available at CPER; use DP1.00044.001 if precip is added later.

sage.comment: Sage/Waggle nodes at or near CPER. X001 (NEON tower coords) is deployed but publishes nothing to the public query API as of 2026-07; H019 is a LoRaWAN gateway with system telemetry only. Kept for the day X001 starts publishing - expect empty output until then.

_known_nodes_not_publishing.note: PTZ camera, LoRaWAN, Orin AGX; publishes nothing public yet
LoRaWAN gateway near the ARS/LTAR station; system telemetry only

static_layers.comment: M2 (Phase 2) inputs - defined here so the analysis grid is fixed before any raster work starts. Not consumed by any M1 job.

analysis_grid.comment: UTM 13N, 10 m; bbox snapped to the grid at build time

soil.polaris_note: van Genuchten params direct from POLARIS - no pedotransfer (SPEC.md section 10). ksat/alpha/om are log10 on the server; the fetcher converts back to linear.
